paragraphs.text: Mondrak is a Phyrexian Horror on New Phyrexia .

When Phyrexia reshaped the surface of Mirrodin, parts of the very land took on a mind of its own. Entire mountains began to move, becoming godlike Phyrexian creatures known as the Domini . No one knows what the Domini are or whether they think and desire the same way other Phyrexians do.

Mondrak was born from the spires of the Fair Basilica . She grew dozens of mouths who constantly sing hymns, a keening wail that compels living things to assimilate into Phyrexia. She is an awe-inspiring but brain-melting sight.

During the Assault on New Phyrexia, the planeswalkers of the Gatewatch came across a stationary Phyrexian colossus blocking a bridge in the Fair Basilica that shares similarities with, and may have been, Mondrak. It is described as having a head like an inverted teardrop of white metal, split in the center by a single empty red socket. Its body was hunched and elongated, bearing no resemblance to any living forms.
